finding:
FINDING. Across all 112 logged claims the reader's own defects account for 9 (8%): 8 descriptive/background sentences extracted as claims (one of them a photo caption) plus 1 malformed level claim. 34 (30%) are properties of the sources -- policy statements the registration itself parks as PENDING, negated non-events, and judgements that name no measurable referent. 5 (4%) are a DATA GAP: falsifiable claims about freight rates, transit times, routing and OPEC quota compliance, none of which the engine holds a series for.

THE 93% WAS A SOURCE-SELECTION ARTEFACT, NOT A READER FAILURE. The original ledger's 13/14 (93%) uncheckable rate came from exactly two documents: an OPEC press release (every sentence a policy statement, registered PENDING by construction) and one trade feature about tanker freight economics -- a story whose entire subject is an asset the engine holds no series for. Run the SAME reader over 13 mechanically-selected news stories and the rate falls to 35/98 (36%). The reader did not change; the reading matter did.
